plugins.name: claude-code-toolkit
plugins.description: 10 slash commands and 3 agent definitions for Claude Code — /build (multi-agent pipeline), /dispatch (parallel tasks), /security-audit, /handoff, /fresh, /init, /plan, /railway-preflight, /verify, /wait-for. Includes planner, coder, and reviewer agents.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Three-phase build: Opus plans → Sonnet implements with tests → Opus reviews. Iterates until passing. Usage: /build [task description]

commands.name: dispatch
commands.description: Plan-then-dispatch: discovers file:line targets before spawning agents. Prevents context exhaustion from vague scoping. Usage: /dispatch [task description]

commands.name: fresh
commands.description: Save context and prepare a clean handoff for a new session. Writes a handoff doc, pushes, and gives you the exact prompt to paste.

commands.name: handoff
commands.description: Write a structured handoff document capturing session state so the next session can continue without re-discovery. Usage: /handoff

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize a new project with standard structure, Claude Code config, and git. Usage: /init <project-name> [type]

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Explore, think, and output a structured plan before executing anything. Usage: /plan [task]

commands.name: railway-preflight
commands.description: Pre-deploy readiness check for Railway. Catches broken Dockerfiles, missing dependencies, and SQLite-incompatible migrations before they cause a failed deploy.

commands.name: security-audit
commands.description: Security and resilience audit for apps built with AI agents. Covers auth, data exposure, error handling, and scale. Usage: /security-audit
